risk_if_not_implemented: Without Invalidate Session Identifiers at Logout, credentials may be phished, replayed, guessed or stolen, allowing unauthorized actors to authenticate as trusted identities. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Non-Repudiation
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a non-repudiation capability to protect against an individual falsely denying having performed a particular action.
compensating_control_1.justification: Non-Repudiation (MON-34) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Invalidate Session Identifiers at Logout (IAC-46) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Integrity of Data In Transit
compensating_control_2.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to detect unauthorized changes to data in transit.
compensating_control_2.justification: Integrity of Data In Transit (CRY-06) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Invalidate Session Identifiers at Logout (IAC-46) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
